The following Discipline powers apply to the clans and bloodlines detailed in the crossover sourcebook The Long Night. They are reproduced here because Laws of Elysium's appendix of new rules and clarifications lists them as an addendum to the core Blood and Willpower rules above.

Abombwe (Master)

Devil-Channel

By spending two Blood Traits, you may channel your Beast to concentrate in one specific area of your body. The concentrated Beast-nature manifests as a film of black, clotted blood covering that body part. The Beast can only be forced into one location at a time — you cannot Devil-Channel into your hands and throat simultaneously. The power lasts five minutes.

  • Hands: You may inflict aggravated damage with your bare, bloody hands. You also gain the Physical Trait Tough for the five minutes this power is active.
  • Torso: You use your Blood Traits more efficiently: while this power is active, you double the number of Physical Traits you can gain through spending blood.
  • Throat: Your voice becomes terrifying. On a successful Social Challenge, all mortals must flee you for 10 minutes. Awakened beings you beat in a Social Challenge while using this power are down two Traits in any challenge involving you for the next 10 minutes.
  • Feet: By stamping your feet on the ground you cause a tremor. Everyone in your vicinity must win a Static Physical Challenge against your Physical Traits or be knocked to the ground for one minute.

Taking the Skin

By slaying a creature and spending a Mental Trait, you subsume the Beast-nature of your victim, transforming yourself into that creature for the remainder of the night. Your victim must be some kind of predator and must have had at least one Blood Trait's worth of vitae (no ants or mosquitoes). Upon completing the transformation, you physically become your victim, gaining its appearance, Physical Traits and abilities.

Note: the full effect only applies against a "natural" creature. Taking the Skin of a Lupine or another vampire only grants you the victim's appearance.
